title: PSF map iterates beyond usable stars and consumes failed measurements
summary: indigo_raw_utils.c:3153-3166: last_star = used_stars-first_star is an exclusive upper bound, but loop uses k <= last_star. For 1-9 usable stars, it consumes stars[used_stars]; at capacity this reads beyond allocation, otherwise a zero-initialized unused entry contaminates edge averages. FF-06 also makes ignoring indigo_selection_psf failure at 3106 material: uninitialized outputs are used. Next: Use k < last_star and retain stars only when PSF succeeds; handle zero/constant usable values. Verify 0/1/9 and capacity-filled star lists with map output.
